t: Remove deprecated inbox/outbox lug folders and create WAI-Hub/lugs/ for hub-specific knowledge
challenge: Hub has deprecated inbox/ and outbox/ folders that should be subsumed into incoming/outgoing/. WAI-Hub/lugs/ doesn't exist — hub-specific work items have no proper home. Lugs README references retired JSONL files.
perceive: 1. ls hub/WAI-Spoke/lugs/inbox/ — 2 files. 2. ls hub/WAI-Spoke/outbox/ — check contents. 3. Confirm hub/WAI-Hub/lugs/ does NOT exist. 4. Read framework/WAI-Spoke/lugs/README.md — check for stale references. 5. Check hub/WAI-Spoke/wheels/basher/WAI-Spoke/lugs/inbox/ for same pattern.
execute: 1. Move hub/WAI-Spoke/lugs/inbox/ contents to hub/WAI-Spoke/lugs/incoming/, remove inbox/. 2. Move hub/WAI-Spoke/outbox/ contents to hub/WAI-Spoke/lugs/outgoing/, remove outbox/. 3. Same for any nested spoke copies (wheels/basher/...). 4. Create hub/WAI-Hub/lugs/bytype/{task,signal,other}/{open,in_progress,completed}/ structure. 5. Update lugs/README.md to reflect current structure. 6. Add lug naming policy to wai-lug-schema.md: id must be meaningful, id=filename, must pass improve process.
verify: 1. find hub/WAI-Spoke -name inbox -o -name outbox returns nothing. 2. test -d hub/WAI-Hub/lugs/bytype confirms structure exists. 3. grep 'WAI-Lugs.jsonl' framework/WAI-Spoke/lugs/README.md returns nothing (stale refs removed). 4. wai-lug-schema.md contains naming policy.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Remove deprecated lug folders, create hub-specific lug structure, add naming policy
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not reviewing individual lug quality — that's the epic (work item 3d)
